data.name: Guardian's Shout
data.description: Your warning shouts keep allies from danger. Whenever you attempt a Reflex save to avoid an effect that affects multiple creatures, you can expend one use of your mythic power to call out a warning to your allies. Any allies within 100 feet who can hear you gain a +%1 bonus on their saving throws against that effect.|MythicLevel
